title: Singing on a record from 'The Music Man Goes Dixieland'
summary: He mentions vocal numbers he recorded around the turn of the 1960s.

story.theme_name: Singers and the musicians who accompanied them

blocks.x: You talked about singing. I know that you did sing too. Do you have a record with you that has one of your vocal numbers on it?
No I don't. I did a thing from 'Music Man Goes Dixieland', 'Music man rather show. And 'A Sadder but Wiser Girl For Me' and it's fairly good. But I don't have it here.
Now the date of that was about what 1960 what? Or was it earlier than that the Music Man? I mean the original show, but when did you do your record?
Well I did it right when the show opened. And by gosh I can't remember when it was.
I was going to say it's around, just around that. The very, very early sixties I think. Probably about the turn of the decade there.
Yes, yes, it's ...... I did 'Troubles, Where have you got troubles'. That's something like a spiritual really.
